sql: SELECT "budget"."School_id" AS k, ("budget"."Budget_invested_percent" - "budget"."total_budget_percent_invested") AS m1 FROM "budget" WHERE ("budget"."Budget_invested_percent" - "budget"."total_budget_percent_invested") IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m1 DESC LIMIT 10
quantities: budget.invested as percent of budgeted minus invested share of total budget
why: invested as percent of budgeted - invested share of total budget: both in percent and of the same kind (stocks) on the same one school's budget in one year
rank budget rows by invested as percent of budgeted minus invested share of total budget

sql: SELECT "budget"."School_id" AS k, ("budget"."total_budget_percent_budgeted" - "budget"."total_budget_percent_invested") AS m1 FROM "budget" WHERE ("budget"."total_budget_percent_budgeted" - "budget"."total_budget_percent_invested") IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m1 DESC LIMIT 10
quantities: budget.budgeted share of total budget minus invested share of total budget
why: budgeted share of total budget - invested share of total budget: both in percent and of the same kind (stocks) on the same one school's budget in one year
rank budget rows by budgeted share of total budget minus invested share of total budget

sql: SELECT "budget"."School_id" AS k, (CAST("budget"."Invested" AS REAL) / "budget"."Budgeted") AS m1 FROM "budget" WHERE (CAST("budget"."Invested" AS REAL) / "budget"."Budgeted") IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m1 DESC LIMIT 10
quantities: budget.amount invested relative to amount budgeted
why: amount invested / amount budgeted: a ratio of two quantities in USD
rank budget rows by amount invested relative to amount budgeted

sql: SELECT "budget"."School_id" AS k, (CAST("budget"."Budget_invested_percent" AS REAL) / "budget"."total_budget_percent_budgeted") AS m1 FROM "budget" WHERE (CAST("budget"."Budget_invested_percent" AS REAL) / "budget"."total_budget_percent_budgeted") IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m1 DESC LIMIT 10
quantities: budget.invested as percent of budgeted relative to budgeted share of total budget
why: invested as percent of budgeted / budgeted share of total budget: a ratio of two quantities in percent
rank budget rows by invested as percent of budgeted relative to budgeted share of total budget

sql: SELECT "budget"."School_id" AS k, ("budget"."Budgeted" - "budget"."Invested") AS m1 FROM "budget" WHERE ("budget"."Budgeted" - "budget"."Invested") IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m1 DESC LIMIT 10
why: amount budgeted - amount invested: both in USD and of the same kind (flows) on the same one school's budget in one year
rank budget rows by amount budgeted minus amount invested
